# GitHub Actions workflows

Follow `skills/pipelines-github-actions-authoring/SKILL.md`. Pin each action to a full commit SHA, keep permissions least privilege, and set a timeout on every job. A job that logs in to Azure or AWS follows `skills/pipelines-oidc-federation/SKILL.md`. A failed run follows `skills/pipelines-github-actions-debugging/SKILL.md`.
